coordinate_space.mapping: canon = (x, -y, -z) from MediaPipe world; det = +1 (no mirror)

angular_acceleration.definition: acc[t] = |omega(t+1/2) - omega(t-1/2)| * fps, omega = local rotation vector rate (deg/s^2)

physical_plausibility_auto.note: root has no translation (pelvis fixed at rig rest height); floor = y 0

clip_content: head turn to the actor's LEFT, body static (verified in source)
verdict: head fixed: holds +40 deg vs 2D estimate +45 (v1 +14.5), hold error 4.8 deg (v1 30.2); body calm, 0 frames above gate. Best clip.

visual_findings.method: preview frames (source|front|side|top) at key frames vs source, v1 preview below (plots/keyframes_v1_v2.png); numbers from v1_vs_v2 and depth_rebuild_diagnostics
findings: Head yaw follows the 2D estimate with a constant ~5 deg shortfall, no decay.
Static arms out of plane <= 12 deg (v1 16); chest co-rotates 12 deg as in v1.

action_items.change: L = max(rest projection, 98th percentile of the projection over the clip) is wrong under real (not weak) perspective: a limb moved toward the camera is magnified, so the p98 is 10-25 % longer than the true length. Every other frame, including the rest pose, then gets sqrt(L^2-d^2) of invented depth. Take L from the rest projection only (rest limbs are in-plane by the baseline definition) and either model perspective (scale each joint's image offset by its depth; focal length from the actor height in pixels, iterate 2-3 times) or cap L at the rest projection x 1.03. Add a test: a planar rest pose plus one limb swung toward a perspective camera must give 0 deg out-of-plane at rest.
action_items.expected: rest out-of-plane of every limb segment < 5 deg (depth_rebuild_diagnostics); hinge_bias_deg back to <= 35 deg in all clips; df1e/619b standing shin vertical in the side view.
action_items.fail: any rest segment still > 10 deg out of plane, or hinge bias > 40 deg.
